notes.title: Update V0.6.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/ce978b175cbfcae292f58ab9017f6e735c8ee5fb.png[/img]



[list]
[*] Various bug fixes.
[*] Improved gameplay visibility.
[*] Added rematch button at the end of the game.
[*] You can briefly pickup enemy players in their own restaurant.
[*] Restaurants no longer take damage from empty chair spots when low on health.
[*] Added a "Hide Room Code" option for streaming.
[/list]
